system.flavor:
String a cord across a hallway at ankle height, rig a line to a stack of pans so it clatters when crossed, or lay a trip across the one path to your camp. It takes the cord and a few moments, and anyone who looks will see it.

Not enough to hide the line from a careful eye or to cover more than one hallway.

body.label: Target
body.html: A line of 2 adjacent empty spaces within 3 units; requires loose cord or similar material.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The line is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. The trap is visible to creatures that inspect it.

surges.html: Move 1 unit while concealing your own approach in existing cover.

rider.title: Contingency - Trap
rider.html: When an enemy voluntarily crosses the line, it takes 1 Piercing Damage after crossing and becomes Exposed until your next turn. Remove the trap.
